description: Source code for managing and retrieving bootloader information in Zephyr OS, including functions for reading shared data TLV entries, handling settings, and initialization.

methods.name: blinfo_lookup
methods.description: Reads a TLV entry from shared MCUboot data based on a key.

methods.name: blinfo_handle_get
methods.description: Handles retrieval of specific bootloader info settings.

methods.name: blinfo_handle_set
methods.description: Handles setting of bootloader info settings, not supported.

methods.name: blinfo_init
methods.description: Initializes the bootloader info subsystem, validates data, and registers settings.
